title: Huldrych Zwingli Briefe: Digitale Texte
author: Huldrych Zwingli and his correspondents
institution: Institut für Schweizerische Reformationsgeschichte, Universität Zürich
region: Zurich and Switzerland, with letters to and from Basel, Vienna, Cologne and elsewhere
license_note: The imprint states: original data © Huldreich Zwinglis sämtliche Werke, Theologischer Verlag Zürich; digital presentation © Institut für Schweizerische Reformationsgeschichte, Universität Zürich. Free to read online.
notes: Each letter is its own page (n=Brief.1 to Brief.790, 804 pages) with the running text of the critical edition Huldreich Zwinglis sämtliche Werke vol. 7-9 (Corpus Reformatorum 94-96, 1911-1925), without the apparatus; letters from 1510 to 1528. Letters 790-1292 (vols. 10-11, 1528-1531) are not online. Searchable by full text, sender, recipient and place. The wiki's change log shows the letters last edited in 2011 and the last change of any page on 1 July 2021, and the site still runs on old PHP, so it is listed as archived. The counts cover all 804 letter pages, fetched once in a browser because the site refuses automated clients. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
